protocol_repair: After the original specification was committed and pushed, static implementation review before any checkpoint load found that the direct-margin Hodge bridge was incorrectly required to reproduce hidden-derived a_N and Y at float64 tolerance. The prior amplitude audit already registered and reported a GPU hidden-to-margin bridge tolerance of 1e-5 and stores a_N_from_margin separately. This repair makes a_N_from_margin the exact 1e-10 direct-margin anchor and retains a_N and Y as historical bridge checks at 1e-5. No checkpoint, field-reassembly cell, hybrid slope, bootstrap result, or diagnostic outcome was inspected before this repair; no cell, contrast, threshold, norm match, or decision rule changes.
scientific_question: Relative to the frozen exact-posterior comparator, is the neural-minus-posterior nonlearned probability-distance slope determined by the additive Hodge field, the Hodge residual, or their combination?
current_theory: The replicated P_T/L_T and differential-evidence-access mechanism remains unchanged. Within the neural policy, the P_T-dependent additive field carries the excessive nonlearned probability-distance slope, but its common-unit additive-potential norm is smaller than the exact-posterior comparator. The remaining problem is field shape and pairwise confidence allocation, not scalar overgain.
diagnostic_hypothesis: A same-unit additive-by-residual field reassembly can determine which frozen neural-versus-posterior field component is sufficient to reproduce the registered probability-slope contrast, while one posterior-to-neural norm match tests additive shape at the neural additive energy.
claim_boundary: This is a read-only offline reassembly of two frozen policy fields on two frozen backbones. It tests algebraic field-level sufficiency relative to one registered exact-posterior comparator. It does not causally identify P_T, W_out, recurrent dynamics, a biological store, the human posterior, or a uniquely correct neural geometry; establish network-population prevalence; fit a temperature; authorize a model intervention; or infer comparator inadequacy from an unresolved result.
registration_timing: The original be265eb contract was frozen after inspecting the amplitude-provenance result on these same two backbones and before writing this diagnostic runner. This source-bridge repair was made after independent static review of the in-progress runner but before loading or replaying either seed-2104 or seed-2105 checkpoint for this diagnostic. This is a sequential mechanism-localization test, not an independent confirmation.

network_contract.checkpoint_selection: Use exactly the jointly hash-locked final checkpoints from the fresh v2.4 confirmation.
network_contract.primary_condition: Pure L-off global replay with intact terminal P_T and frozen W_out; no local trace is constructed or read.
network_contract.participant_inference: Bootstrap all 77 participants separately within each network. Never pool participant rows or bootstrap draws across networks.

runtime_contract.visible_cuda_gpu: required for the single frozen neural margin replay
runtime_contract.all_seed_execution: Both networks must complete in one command before the result is written.

posterior_comparator.hypothesis_log_weights: ell_pi=-E(pi)/0.05 from the exact frozen posterior and each participant's realized stable-omission evidence.
posterior_comparator.comparator_boundary: This frozen exact posterior is a scientific comparator, not the human posterior or ground-truth neural geometry.

field_contract.edge_order: All 28 unordered item pairs in lexicographic integer order, with both query orientations used to form each antisymmetric neural margin.
field_contract.sign: Canonical edge fields are oriented by the lexicographic pair. Multiply by the frozen source-correct sign y_ij only after field construction so positive probability means the correct source order.
field_contract.primary_pair_subset: The same 20 nonlearned pairs used by Track B; learned support pairs are excluded before every symbolic-distance slope.
field_contract.neural_margin: m_N is the intact pure-global response margin from the frozen P_T branch and W_out, with orientation antisymmetrization exactly matching Track B.
field_contract.posterior_margin: m_P=T_choice[logsumexp(log w_pi:i>j)-logsumexp(log w_pi:j>i)] from the same participant's realized stable-omission evidence, posterior temperature 0.05, and T_choice=0.25, without probability clipping.
field_contract.hodge_decomposition: For x in {N,P}, s_x=B_plus m_x, g_x=B s_x, and c_x=m_x-g_x on the complete graph in the minimum-norm zero-sum gauge.
field_contract.choice_link: For any reassembled canonical margin m, p_ij=sigmoid(y_ij m_ij/0.25). No link, temperature, intercept, or field component is fitted.
field_contract.field_reassembly_boundary: The hybrid fields are offline counterfactual policy fields. They are not recurrent rollouts and do not define realizable network states.

factorial_contract.S_NN: Per-participant symbolic-distance slope of sigmoid[y(g_N+c_N)/T] over the 20 nonlearned pairs.
factorial_contract.S_PN: Per-participant symbolic-distance slope of sigmoid[y(g_P+c_N)/T] over the 20 nonlearned pairs.
factorial_contract.S_NP: Per-participant symbolic-distance slope of sigmoid[y(g_N+c_P)/T] over the 20 nonlearned pairs.
factorial_contract.S_PP: Per-participant symbolic-distance slope of sigmoid[y(g_P+c_P)/T] over the 20 nonlearned pairs.
factorial_contract.additive_main_effect: A=0.5[(S_NN-S_PN)+(S_NP-S_PP)]. Positive A means the neural additive source produces a steeper slope on average across residual sources.
factorial_contract.residual_main_effect: R=0.5[(S_NN-S_NP)+(S_PN-S_PP)]. Positive R means the neural residual source produces a steeper slope on average across additive sources.
factorial_contract.interaction: I=(S_NN-S_PN)-(S_NP-S_PP). Interaction is decided only from this registered probability-slope contrast, never from failure of one-cell closure. Positive I means the neural-versus-posterior additive effect is larger under c_N than under c_P; negative I means the reverse.
factorial_contract.dependent_contrast_identities: For every participant and bootstrap draw, D=A+R=Delta_A+C_A=Delta_R+C_R=Q_shape+C_shape; I=Delta_A-C_R=Delta_R-C_A; Delta_A=A+I/2; C_A=R-I/2; Delta_R=R+I/2; C_R=A-I/2; Delta_A=Q_shape+Q_amp; and C_shape=C_A+Q_amp. These are algebraically dependent summaries, not independent confirmation links.
factorial_contract.margin_space_interaction: The corresponding fixed-design OLS interaction on the four pre-sigmoid correct-margin cells must be exactly zero within tolerance. Nonzero I after the sigmoid is a probability-link field-reassembly interaction, not a recurrent or network interaction.

norm_matched_additive_control.single_registered_direction: Scale the posterior additive edge field to the neural additive edge-field norm separately within participant; never scale neural to posterior.
norm_matched_additive_control.equation: g_P_tilde=g_P ||g_N||_2/||g_P||_2, using all 28 canonical edges before correctness signing or nonlearned selection.
norm_matched_additive_control.target: ||g_P_tilde||_2=||g_N||_2. On the complete graph this is the same scale ratio as the registered zero-sum item-potential norms. Both ||g_N||_2 and ||g_P||_2 must exceed 1e-12, with no epsilon.
norm_matched_additive_control.fixed_residual: Use c_N in both fields so only additive direction/shape differs at the neural additive norm.
norm_matched_additive_control.estimands: S_tildePN is the slope of sigmoid[y(g_P_tilde+c_N)/T]; Q_shape=S_NN-S_tildePN; C_shape=S_tildePN-S_PP; and Q_amp=S_tildePN-S_PN, so Delta_A=Q_shape+Q_amp.
norm_matched_additive_control.energy_identity: Because every complete-graph Hodge gradient is orthogonal to c_N, verify ||g_P_tilde+c_N||_2^2=||g_N+c_N||_2^2 within participant. The control matches complete pre-sigmoid edge-field energy, not post-sigmoid probability amplitude.
norm_matched_additive_control.interpretation: Material positive Q_shape supports a steeper neural additive shape/allocation at matched additive norm and fixed neural residual. Norm-matched shape replacement is sufficient only if Q_shape is material positive and C_shape is equivalent to zero. Equivalence or nonclosure does not prove that shape is globally irrelevant or that the natural additive effect is an amplitude effect, because natural scale can interact with the sigmoid and residual. Q_amp is reported as the fixed-shape scaling contrast, not a separate scale intervention. No other norm-match direction or primary scale control may be added.

statistical_estimands.subject_slope: Fixed-design OLS cov(p,d)/var(d) over the same 20 nonlearned pairs, computed separately for every participant and cell.

bootstrap.rule: Use one registered participant-resampling count matrix per network and recompute every cell slope mean and paired contrast from the same draw. Edges are fixed and never resampled. All 10000 estimates must be finite; never discard an undefined draw.

statistical_estimands.descriptive_direction_rule: A descriptive positive or negative direction requires the registered 95 percent participant-bootstrap interval to exclude zero. Descriptive direction never selects a registered branch.
statistical_estimands.mutually_exclusive_status_rule: For every decision contrast, material_positive requires lower95>+0.005; material_negative requires upper95<-0.005; equivalent requires the entire 90 percent interval inside [-0.005,+0.005]; otherwise the status is unresolved. These four states are mutually exclusive.
statistical_estimands.equivalence_rule: A contrast is equivalent to zero only when its entire registered 90 percent participant-bootstrap interval lies within [-0.005,+0.005] probability-slope units. An interval merely containing zero is unresolved.
statistical_estimands.equivalence_rationale: The margin is at most one half percentage point of correct-choice probability per symbolic-distance step and less than 10 percent of either previously frozen Track-B neural-minus-posterior slope mismatch.
statistical_estimands.replication_rule: Every primary status and fingerprint must pass separately in both 2104 and 2105 with the same registered rule. Never pool networks.
statistical_estimands.dependent_outcomes: A, R, Delta, closure, and I are algebraically dependent summaries of the same four cells, not independent links. Report their registered statuses without counting them as convergent confirmations.
statistical_estimands.multiple_axes: Field-source fingerprint, A/R descriptions, probability-link I, and norm-matched shape are separate prospectively registered axes. Report all of them; do not select the numerically largest contrast post hoc.

registered_decisions.integrity_failure: Any source, artifact, runtime, parameter-immutability, subject-count, mask, reconstruction, denominator, anchor-reproduction, norm-match, or bootstrap-finiteness gate fails.
registered_decisions.premise_not_confirmed: After all raw endpoint reproduction gates pass, D does not have a positive 95 percent lower bound separately in both networks.
registered_decisions.main_effect_descriptions: Classify A and R in each network by the mutually exclusive material/equivalence rule and report cross-network agreement. Because D=A+R, they are not two independent confirmation links.
registered_decisions.interaction_axis: Classify probability-link I independently by the mutually exclusive material/equivalence rule. Failure of either replacement to close is never interaction evidence.
registered_decisions.additive_replacement_sufficient: In both networks Delta_A is material_positive and C_A is equivalent.
registered_decisions.residual_replacement_sufficient: In both networks Delta_R is material_positive and C_R is equivalent.
registered_decisions.both_components_material: In both networks Delta_A, C_A, Delta_R, and C_R are each material_positive, giving material S_NN>S_PN>S_PP and S_NN>S_NP>S_PP. Interaction status remains a separate axis.
registered_decisions.field_source_fingerprint_priority: After integrity and premise gates: both_replacements_sufficient if both replacement-sufficiency rules pass; additive_replacement_only if only additive passes; residual_replacement_only if only residual passes; both_components_material if its rule passes; otherwise mixed_or_unresolved. These branches are mutually exclusive and are never chosen by effect size.
registered_decisions.norm_matched_shape_axis: Classify Q_shape, C_shape, and Q_amp by the same mutually exclusive rule. norm_matched_shape_replacement_sufficient requires Q_shape material_positive and C_shape equivalent separately in both networks; it is reported separately and cannot alone authorize a next model stage.
registered_decisions.decision_priority: Apply integrity and premise gates first. Then report the mutually exclusive field-source fingerprint, dependent A/R descriptions, probability-link I status, and norm-matched shape status as separate axes.

integrity_gates.formal_runtime: visible GPU, one PyTorch intra-op thread, and one inter-op thread
integrity_gates.complete_execution: both networks, all 77 participants, 28 canonical edges, 56 neural query orientations, and the fixed 20-pair nonlearned mask
integrity_gates.neural_anchor: S_NN must reproduce every participant's frozen Track-B beta_p.
integrity_gates.posterior_anchor: S_PP must reproduce every participant's frozen Track-B beta_p_posterior.
integrity_gates.mismatch_anchor: D must reproduce every participant's frozen Track-B beta_p_minus_posterior.
integrity_gates.field_reconstruction: m_N=g_N+c_N and m_P=g_P+c_P exactly within tolerance; both Hodge residuals are orthogonal to the complete-graph gradient space and both item potentials use the zero-sum gauge.
integrity_gates.probability_reconstruction: The NN and PP choice fields exactly reproduce the frozen neural and posterior probabilities within tolerance.
integrity_gates.amplitude_audit_direct_margin_bridge: For n=8 complete-graph Hodge fields, ||g_N||_edge/sqrt(8) must reproduce every participant's frozen a_N_from_margin and ||g_P||_edge/sqrt(8) must reproduce frozen a_post within 1e-10. The internally reconstructed Y_margin=log(||g_N||_edge/||g_P||_edge) must equal log(a_N_from_margin/a_post) within 1e-10. This prevents substitution of the Track-B probability or expected-rank field for the common-unit posterior margin field.
integrity_gates.amplitude_audit_historical_bridge: The same direct-margin a_N bridge may differ from the frozen hidden/readout-derived a_N, and Y_margin may differ from frozen Y=log(a_N/a_post), only within the already registered GPU_neural_margin_reproduction_tolerance of 1e-5. Report both signed differences; do not silently relabel the historical amplitude estimand.
integrity_gates.posterior: orientation reversal and sigmoid inverse-link identities pass without clipping.
integrity_gates.norm_match: Every neural and posterior additive edge-field norm is above 1e-12; ||g_P_tilde||_2=||g_N||_2 and ||g_P_tilde+c_N||_2^2=||g_N+c_N||_2^2 within tolerance; no epsilon, clipping, or participant filtering.
integrity_gates.factorial: Every hybrid field is formed only from the registered matched participant's g and c components. Every participant and bootstrap draw must satisfy D=A+R=Delta_A+C_A=Delta_R+C_R=Q_shape+C_shape; I=Delta_A-C_R=Delta_R-C_A; Delta_A=A+I/2; C_A=R-I/2; Delta_R=R+I/2; C_R=A-I/2; Delta_A=Q_shape+Q_amp; and C_shape=C_A+Q_amp within tolerance.
integrity_gates.margin_interaction: The fixed-design OLS additive-by-residual interaction across the four pre-sigmoid correct-margin fields is zero within tolerance for every participant.
integrity_gates.no_filtering_or_posthoc_repair: No participant, edge, network, field component, norm target, comparator, contrast, threshold, or result may be removed, replaced, added, or redefined after execution.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.additive_replacement_sufficient: Relative to the frozen comparator, posterior-additive replacement is sufficient to close the fixed probability-slope contrast. The natural replacement changes both additive norm and direction, so it does not alone identify shape/allocation. It may motivate, but does not confirm, a separately registered P_T-to-g_N question.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.residual_replacement_sufficient: Preserve Track B's within-neural additive-dominance result, but revise the cross-comparator explanation: c_N's nonlinear combination with the additive field and sigmoid is sufficient for the neural/posterior probability-space contrast.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.both_components_material: Treat the fixed pairwise confidence contrast as a joint additive-plus-residual field property and prohibit a single-component intervention. Whether their probability-link dependence is materially nonadditive is decided only by I.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.interaction: Material positive I means the neural-versus-posterior additive effect is larger under c_N than c_P; material negative I means the reverse. Equivalent I supports no material probability-link factorial interaction under the frozen margin. None is recurrent or network interaction evidence.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.norm_matched_shape: A material positive Q_shape supports neural-versus-posterior additive shape/global allocation only at the neural full-28-edge norm and fixed c_N operating point. The 20-pair analysis-subset norm is not held fixed; redistribution between learned and nonlearned edges is part of this estimand. Sufficiency additionally requires C_shape equivalence. Equivalent or unresolved Q_shape cannot reclassify the natural additive replacement as amplitude or saturation, and this axis alone never licenses a scalar repair or GO decision.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.unresolved: Retain comparator_sensitive_unresolved and, only under a separately frozen adequacy criterion, reassess the comparator. Do not tune the model, posterior temperature, choice temperature, norm, or field decomposition.

stop_go.current_stage: Read-only only. No intervention or model change is authorized by this contract.
stop_go.no_scalar_route: Temperature fitting, P_T normalization, W_out normalization, neural-to-posterior norm scaling, and any other scalar calibration remain closed.
stop_go.no_v2_4_change: Do not alter differential evidence access, L_T, P_T, local gain, address, write, read, recurrent dynamics, activation, or output readout.
stop_go.no_extra_controls: Do not append a second norm-match direction, alternative comparator, learned-pair analysis, human target, new distance measure, or post-hoc interaction after seeing the cells.
stop_go.joint_result: If both components are material or both replacements are sufficient, do not select a single component for intervention.
stop_go.unresolved_result: Close additional hybrid, norm, mask, temperature, and comparator variants on seeds 2104 and 2105. Comparator adequacy requires a separate prospective criterion, not another post-hoc cell.
stop_go.norm_match_result: The norm-matched axis cannot by itself trigger network localization or intervention.
stop_go.next_stage: Any implementable or causal follow-up requires a new prospectively frozen contract and one to three new development backbones after this result is reported.

reporting.required_raw_subject_arrays: Retain every S/A/R/I/Delta/closure/norm-match estimand plus ||g_N||_2, ||g_P||_2, posterior-to-neural scale k, ||c_N||_2, ||c_P||_2, and all norm-match reconstruction and orthogonality errors for every participant.
reporting.next_action: Commit and push this specification before implementation or checkpoint replay.
